name: Half-Plate of the Dark Prince
body:
Source Inner Sea Gods pg. 252
Aura faint conjuration and enchantment CL 3rd
Slot armor; Price 3,910 gp; Weight 50 lbs.
Description
This regal-looking +1 half-plate is a status symbol in the church of Asmodeus, and is decorated with red infernal symbols and an inverted pentagram. The wearer can use charm person and infernal healingISWG each once per day.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, charm person, infernal healingISWG; Price 2,330 gp
